name: Strike and correct
visual_intent: Myth versus fact made visible: a claim types in, is struck through, steps back small and grey, and the correction types in under it.

performance_characteristics.dom_node_count: character spans of both lines + 1 SVG path
performance_characteristics.memory_profile: Low (estimate, not measured on the M2)

implementation_summary: Studio.type.strike draws a hand line (or a scribble) through the claim inside the claim element, so it rides the demotion; Studio.type.strikeCorrect splits both lines into characters, types the claim, strikes it, holds it `read` seconds, demotes it (shrink-up, fade or fall) and types the correction.
runtime_api: Studio.type.strikeCorrect(tl, claim, correction, at, {cps, read, demote, scale, lift, dim, gap, strike}); Studio.type.strike(tl, el, at, {color, duration, overshoot, y, style})

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/backlog-techniques.html (strike inside the claim, drawn on its cue, correction hidden while the claim is read, claim demoted, correction typed) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; frame review tests/reference-derived/scramble-strike-caption/qa/report.json (0 errors, 0 warnings). Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
